author: GitHub
description:
During our OpenClaw fireside chat, entrepreneur Dave Morin shares a personal story about his early experiences with Apple computers. He compares the magic of learning HyperCard and AppleScript to the creative freedom he now feels using OpenClaw. The speed and capability of this open source AI agent inspired him to reach out directly to creator Peter Steinberger. Watch this short clip to hear why he believes the community needs to protect this project for the long term.
